```{ojs}
//| label: js-data-generation

logit = p => Math.log(p / (1 - p));

buildDataset = (count, seed, isTrain = false, overrideConfig = null) => {
  // Use a seeded PRNG so that slider adjustments don't cause the entire dataset to jump randomly
  const lcg = d3.randomLcg(seed);
  const randomNormal = d3.randomNormal.source(lcg)(0, 1);
  const randomUniform = d3.randomUniform.source(lcg)(0, 1);

  // Configuration values (override vs global slider)
  const conf_fp = overrideConfig && overrideConfig.feature_predictivity !== undefined ? overrideConfig.feature_predictivity : feature_predictivity;
  const conf_px = overrideConfig && overrideConfig.proxies !== undefined ? overrideConfig.proxies : proxies;
  const conf_td = overrideConfig && overrideConfig.task_diff !== undefined ? overrideConfig.task_diff : task_diff;
  const conf_lb = overrideConfig && overrideConfig.label_bias !== undefined ? overrideConfig.label_bias : label_bias;
  const conf_br = overrideConfig && overrideConfig.base_rate_diff !== undefined ? overrideConfig.base_rate_diff : base_rate_diff;

  // Parse base rates from dropdown (e.g. "0.25 / 0.50")
  let [privRate, disadvRate] = conf_br.split("/").map(Number);
  if (!isTrain) {
    privRate = 0.5;
    disadvRate = 0.5;
  }
  
  const dataset = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    // 1. Sensitive attribute S ~ Bernoulli(0.5)
    // S = 0 (Privileged), S = 1 (Disadvantaged)
    const S = randomUniform() < 0.5 ? 1 : 0;
    
    // 2. Base rate lookup
    const p = (S === 1) ? disadvRate : privRate;
    
    // 3. True label logit and Y
    // Logistic(0, 1) can be sampled as log(u / (1-u)) where u ~ U(0,1)
    const u = randomUniform();
    const logistic_noise = Math.log(u / (1 - u));
    const Y_score = logit(p) + logistic_noise;
    const Y = Y_score > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    
    // 4. Latent features X_y and X_s
    // Random noise pre-sampled so it stays stable even if sigma is 0
    const noise_y = randomNormal();
    const noise_s = randomNormal();
    const noise_task = randomNormal();
    const noise_label = randomNormal();

    // Convert sliders [0, 1] to actual noise standard deviations (sigma)
    // 0 = Realistic Baseline (No additional bias injected) -> target AUCs
    // 1 = Full Bias Injected
    
    // For Feature Predictivity: "Full Bias" means features are extremely noisy
    const sigma_y = 0.5518 + conf_fp * (2.7911 - 0.5518);
    
    // For Proxies: "Full Bias" means proxies perfectly separate the groups (sigma_s decreases to 0)
    const sigma_s = 0.6823 * (1 - conf_px);

    const X_y = Y + noise_y * sigma_y;
    const X_s = S + noise_s * sigma_s;
    
    // 5. Task Difficulty (on disadvantaged X_y only)
    // Map the [0,1] slider to a maximum sigma of 2.7911
    const sigma_task = conf_td * 2.7911;
    const X_y_prime = X_y + (S === 1 ? noise_task * sigma_task : 0);
    const X_s_prime = X_s; // No noise added to X_s here
    
    // 6. Label Bias (on disadvantaged only)
    let Y_score_prime = Y_score;
    // Label bias is injected only on the training set
    // Map the [0,1] slider to a maximum sigma of 2.7911
    const sigma_label = conf_lb * 2.7911;
    if (S === 1 && isTrain) {
      Y_score_prime = Y_score - Math.abs(noise_label * sigma_label);
    }
    const Y_prime = Y_score_prime > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    
    dataset.push({
      id: `pt_${i}`,
      S: S,
      Y: Y,
      Y_prime: Y_prime,
      X_y_prime: X_y_prime,
      X_s_prime: X_s_prime,
      original_class: Y === 1 ? "Positive" : "Negative",
      class: Y_prime === 1 ? "Positive" : "Negative",
      group: S === 1 ? "Disadvantaged" : "Privileged"
    });
  }
  return dataset;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: reactive-data
// Train set
active_data = buildDataset(total_samples, 42, true)
// Validation set
val_pool = buildDataset(1000, 100, false)
// Test set
test_pool = buildDataset(1000, 200, false)
```
